page_title: NAN 5-3 LOR | Nantes v Lorient 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' 5 - 3 Moses Simon (Nantes) sends Yvon Mvogo the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
90+8' Moses Simon (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+7' Lorient earn a corner.
90+6' Igor Silva (Lorient) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+6' Igor Silva (Lorient) is penalised for holding. Florent Batta signals a set piece. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Nantes!
90+6' Igor Silva (Lorient) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Lorient have a corner.

90+6' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the bottom left corner, Remy Descamps didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
90+5' Kader Bamba (Nantes) is penalised for a foul. Florent Batta had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+3' Marquinhos (Nantes) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Yvon Mvogo produces a wonderful reflex save.
90+1' Booking. Romain Faivre (Lorient) receives a caution from the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Florent Mollet will be replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).
89' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) probably handled the ball.
87' Florent Mollet (Nantes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
85' 4 - 3 Goal - 4:3! Romain Faivre tees up Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) inside the box and he rolls the ball past Remy Descamps.
83' 4 - 2 Goal! Moses Simon provides Florent Mollet (Nantes) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 4:2.
81' Remy Descamps (Nantes) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
80' Pierre Aristouy has decided to make a change. Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) replaces Jean-Kevin Duverne.
80' Mostafa Mohamed goes off the pitch and Marquinhos (Nantes) comes on.

77' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
75' 3 - 2 Goal! Romain Faivre (Lorient) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 3:2.
74' It's time for a substitution. Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) comes on in place of Julien Ponceau.
73' Benjamin Mendy (Lorient) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Florent Batta no option but to blow his whistle.
71' Lorient are seeing far more of the ball now.
70' Igor Silva (Lorient) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
67' Souleymane Isaak Toure (Lorient) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
67' Igor Silva (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Igor Silva (Lorient) for Gedeon Kalulu.
63' Here is a change. Vincent Le Goff is going off and Regis Le Bris gives the last tactical orders to Benjamin Mendy (Lorient).
63' Substitution. Eli Junior Kroupi walks off the pitch and Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) comes on as a substitute.
62' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
61' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Moses Simon (Nantes) inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Nantes are awarded a corner kick.
60' The substitution is prepared. Kader Bamba (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matthis Abline.
60' Referee Florent Batta sees the trip by Douglas Augusto (Nantes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
58' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Remy Descamps, who smothers the ball.

55' 3 - 1 Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top left corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 3:1.
53' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
53' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
52' Lorient work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
52' Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
51' Moses Simon (Nantes) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
49' Matthis Abline (Nantes) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yvon Mvogo.
46' 2 - 1 Gooal! Florent Mollet takes over corner duties. Eray Comert (Nantes) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 2:1.
46' Corner kick. Florent Mollet (Nantes) is ready to send the ball into the box.
46' Moses Simon (Nantes) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Nantes force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Lorient string together a series of short passes.
42' 1 - 1 Matthis Abline (Nantes) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nantes.

38' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Yvon Mvogo makes a great save to stop his effort. The ball goes out of play and Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
35' Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient) tackles a bit over-zealously and Florent Batta blows for a foul.
35' Julien Laporte (Lorient) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

33' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
31' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Remy Descamps intercepts the ball.
29' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Yvon Mvogo (Lorient) leaps to collect the ball.
29' Matthis Abline (Nantes) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Nantes get a corner.
27' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
25' Lorient keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
22' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.

19' Moses Simon (Nantes) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
17' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Remy Descamps stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
16' Florent Mollet (Nantes) sends a long ball forward to Moses Simon, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
13' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
13' Dangerous play by Romain Faivre (Lorient). Florent Batta blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
10' Some great controlled play and passing from Lorient. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
7' Florent Mollet (Nantes) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
6' 0 - 1 Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) heads the ball low inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Florent Mollet (Nantes) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lorient will have the kick-off.
Florent Batta is introduced as the referee for today's match.
